text: BREAKING: UK PM Starmer Meets Xi Jinping in Push to Reset Strained Ties | AC1ZBritish Prime Minister Keir Starmer met Chinese President Xi Jinping in Beijing as part of a high-profile visit aimed at resetting strained relations between Britain and China. The talks focused on strengthening economic cooperation, rebuilding political trust, and exploring long-term strategic partnership opportunities after years of diplomatic tensions.
